name: @pipeworx/mcp-whiskyhunter

tools.name: list_distilleries
tools.description: List whisky distilleries tracked by whiskyhunter.net (300+ distilleries with auction data). Returns each distillery name, slug, and country. Use the slug with distillery_prices to get its auction price history. Keyless.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on distillery name, e.g. "macallan", "glen".

tools.name: distillery_prices
tools.description: A single distillery's monthly online whisky-auction price/volume history: per-month max/min/mean winning bid, total trading volume, and lots count. Prices are in the auctions' reporting currency and aggregate many online auction houses. Pass a distillery slug from list_distilleries (e.g. "macallan", "8_doors"). Returns the most recent ~60 months. Keyless.

tools.name: auction_stats
tools.description: Latest aggregate monthly stats per online whisky-auction house: mean winning bid, total trading volume, lots count for that house, and the all-auctions total lots count for the month. Aggregates online whisky-auction data; prices are in each house's reporting currency. Keyless.

limit.description: Max auction-house records to return, newest first (default 25, max 60).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-whiskyhunter forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the whiskyhunter pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
